meta.title: For You — Love Letters for Every Occasion
meta.description: Sixteen “open when” love letters for the sad days, the heavy days, the hopeful days and every day in between. A digital collection to give to someone you love.
meta.og_title: For You — a collection of love letters
meta.og_description: Letters for the days when someone needs to feel loved, understood, and reminded that they are not alone.

hero.lede: Sixteen letters for the quiet days, the heavy days, the hopeful days, and every day in between. Written so the person you love never has to face them alone.
hero.cta_note: Digital PDF in English. Continues to secure checkout.
hero.scene_label: Two illustrated figures. One holds a bundle of letters tied with a ribbon and lavender, and offers it to the other.

intro.statement: This is not a book you read from start to finish. It is a collection of letters waiting for the right moment.
intro.body: When a feeling arrives, you turn to the letter written for it. Some days you’ll need more than one. That is okay. There is no right or wrong order.
intro.aside: And if you want me beside you… I am here.
intro.img_alt: A small bundle of letters tied with a green ribbon and a sprig of lavender

moments.title: What does your heart need today?
moments.lede: Choose the feeling closest to yours. A letter will find you.
moments.envelope_hint: Choose a feeling and a letter will find you.
moments.after: Some words are meant to find you at exactly the right moment.
moments.cta_note: All 16 letters, complete, in one keepsake PDF.
moments.scene_label: The two figures react to the letter you open.

moods.label: I just need to feel loved
It’s late and my mind won’t rest

wall.title: Open when…
wall.lede: Sixteen envelopes, each written for a particular kind of day. Open one to read how it begins.

ui.glimpse: This is only a glimpse. The full letter is waiting in the collection.

letters.title: Open When You’re Sad
letters.epigraph: You are allowed to be sad. And you are still so deeply loved.
letters.line: I can’t promise I can immediately fix what is hurting you. But I can promise that you do not have to sit with it alone.
letters.label: To hold close
letters.quote: I will not rush you to feel better. I will simply stay.
letters.img_alt: Two hands holding a warm painted mug

letters.title: Open When You’re Overwhelmed
letters.epigraph: Stop for a second. Breathe in. Breathe out.
letters.line: You do not have to solve all of it tonight. Just the next small thing.
letters.label: Breathe
letters.quote: Put one thing down. Just one. The world can wait for you to catch your breath.
letters.img_alt: A glass of water beside a sprig of rosemary

letters.title: Open When You Need a Hug
letters.epigraph: Consider this a hug in letter form.
letters.line: It is not the real thing, so this also counts as a voucher: one real hug, redeemable at any time, no expiry date, no questions asked.
letters.label: Voucher
letters.quote: One real hug. Redeemable at any time, no expiry date, no questions asked.

letters.title: Open When You Need Hope
letters.epigraph: The sun does not ask permission to come up in the morning. It just does.
letters.line: Remember the things God has already carried you through. This is not the first hard season you have faced — and look, you are still here.
letters.label: Truth
letters.quote: This season will pass. Seasons always do. Morning is coming.
letters.closing: Keep your head up. Morning is coming.
letters.img_alt: A small green sprout growing from dark soil

letters.title: Open When You Feel Alone
letters.epigraph: You have a person choosing you on purpose — every day, in every season.
letters.line: Loneliness can be a liar. It tells you that no one would understand, that you are too much, that reaching out is a burden.
letters.label: Promise
letters.quote: Send me a single dot if that is all you have got. I will know what it means.
letters.img_alt: Two ceramic mugs side by side

letters.title: Open When You Need to Remember That I Love You
letters.wall_label: you need to remember I love you
letters.epigraph: My love is not a fair-weather thing. It stays. It chooses. It remains.
letters.line: I love you. Not only on the easy days, when you are laughing and everything is fine. On the heavy days too. Especially then.
letters.label: Forever
letters.quote: I love you. Read it again if you need to. It is still true.
letters.img_alt: A small bouquet of pink wild roses and olive leaves

letters.title: Open When the Day Feels Heavy
letters.epigraph: This moment does not define your entire story. It is a difficult chapter.
letters.line: God gives the hardest battles to His strongest soldiers — but even strong soldiers need rest, need encouragement, need someone to stand beside them.
letters.label: Rest
letters.quote: You do not have to be strong every second. You can rest. You can cry. You can be quiet.
letters.closing: This battle is difficult. You are not weak.
letters.img_alt: A clay bowl of smooth river stones with olive leaves

letters.title: Open When You Need Strength
letters.epigraph: Strength is not never feeling tired. Strength is continuing even when you are.
letters.line: You have walked through fire before and come out still standing. You will do it again.
letters.label: Take heart
letters.quote: Take the next breath. Take the next step. That is enough.
letters.closing: I’m proud of you for continuing. Truly.
letters.img_alt: A small terracotta oil lamp with a lit flame

letters.title: Open When You’re Missing Me
letters.epigraph: You are carried with me. In the ordinary moments. In the quiet ones.
letters.line: When something good happens, I want to tell you first. When something hard lands, I wish you were close enough to hold.
letters.label: Near or far
letters.quote: Tell me about your day, even the boring parts. I want all of it.
letters.closing: Counting the days until I’m close again.
letters.img_alt: A brass compass resting on an old map

letters.title: Open When We Need to Reconnect
letters.epigraph: Us against the problem. Not me against you.
letters.line: When something hurts you, talk to me. When you need space, I will respect it. When you need comfort, I will give it.
letters.label: Partners
letters.quote: I do not want to win against you. I want us to win together.
letters.closing: I’m on your side. Always have been.
letters.img_alt: A wooden table with two chairs facing each other

letters.title: Open When Something Good Happens
letters.epigraph: Your joy is not background noise to me — it is something I pay attention to.
letters.line: I am cheering for you from the front row. Always. This is beautiful. And so are you.
letters.label: Celebrate
letters.quote: Good moments are allowed to simply be good. Let yourself enjoy this.
letters.img_alt: A painted bowl of figs and cherries

letters.title: Open Just Because
letters.epigraph: You do not need a reason to be loved. You do not need to earn softness from me.
letters.line: No crisis. No special occasion. Just this: I was thinking about you.
letters.label: Simple truth
letters.quote: I am glad you exist. I am glad you are mine to love. That is all. That is enough.

letters.title: A Morning Note for You
letters.epigraph: You are starting this day already loved. Nothing will change that.
letters.line: God is already ahead of you in this day. He knows what it holds, and He has not forgotten you for a single second.
letters.label: Gentle start
letters.quote: Drink some water. Take a slow breath. One thing at a time is still progress.
letters.closing: Have a soft morning. I’m with you.
letters.img_alt: A ceramic jug, a glass of water and half a lemon on a tray

letters.title: A Night Note for You
letters.epigraph: Whatever this day held, you do not have to carry it all into sleep.
letters.line: The day is ending. You made it through.
letters.label: Rest
letters.quote: Rest is not quitting. You are allowed to stop. Set it down.
letters.img_alt: A lit candle beside a leather-bound journal

letters.title: Open When You’re Doubting Yourself
letters.epigraph: I see you more clearly than the doubt does.
letters.line: You are not behind. You are not failing. You are becoming. And becoming is rarely tidy or linear.
letters.label: Remember
letters.quote: Trust the evidence of your own life more than the accusations of a hard day.
letters.closing: I see you. I choose you. Still.
letters.img_alt: An antique hand mirror with green leaves

letters.title: A Prayer for Us & Closing Words
letters.epigraph: If you remember only one thing: you are not alone.
letters.line: Keep your head up. Keep trusting God. And when life gets heavy… come to me.
letters.label: A prayer for us
letters.quote: Remind her that she does not have to carry everything alone. Protect her heart. Guide her steps.
letters.closing: Us against the problem. Always. I’m here.
letters.img_alt: Two hands resting gently on top of each other

product.title: For You

product.body: A keepsake PDF of sixteen letters, a dedication, and a closing prayer, laid out like a handwritten book and illustrated with small painted objects: a warm mug, a glass of water, a candle for the night.

value.title: Something to return to
value.lede: A gift that isn’t only for one day. It waits for whichever day it happens to be.
moments: you need to find each other again
they need reminding they’re not alone
value.give_body: To the one who carries so much and still finds room for you. For a partner far away, a partner in a hard season, or one you simply want to remind that they are chosen.
value.keep_body: For yourself, for the nights you need to read that rest is not quitting, and the mornings you need to start the day already loved.
value.img_alt: Painting of an open book, a clay jug of lavender and a cup of tea on a wooden table

faith.label: A prayer for us
faith.title: Keep trusting God.
faith.body: Faith runs quietly through these pages. Not as a sermon, but the way it lives inside a relationship: remembering what you’ve already been carried through, and praying for each other.
faith.quote: He is still working, even when you cannot see what He is doing.
prayer: Give her peace when her mind feels overwhelmed.
Remind her that she does not have to carry everything alone.
Protect her heart. Guide her steps.
faith.img_alt: Two hands resting on each other

final.title: Keep the words close.
final.lede: For the days when they need to hear it, and the days they don’t know they do.
final.remember: You are not alone. Keep your head up. And when life gets heavy, come close.
final.cta_note: Digital PDF in English. Continues to secure checkout.
final.scene_label: The two figures walk toward each other and hold each other close.

footer.note: These letters are words of love and encouragement. They are not therapy and are not a substitute for professional care. If you or someone you love is struggling, please reach out to a qualified professional or local support services.
